mapper.sql: id, user_id, portfolio_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, fx_rate, fee, traded_at, trade_date, buy_reason, target_price, sentiment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, portfolio_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, fx_rate, fee, traded_at, trade_date, buy_reason, target_price, sentiment) VALUES (#{userId}, #{portfolioId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{fxRate}, #{fee}, #{tradedAt}, #{tradeDate}, #{buyReason}, #{targetPrice}, #{sentiment})
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.symbol, s.name, t.side, t.quantity, t.price, t.fx_rate AS fxRate, t.fee, t.traded_at AS tradedAt, t.trade_date AS tradeDate, t.buy_reason AS buyReason, t.target_price AS targetPrice, t.sentiment,
NULL AS realizedPnlKrw FROM transactions t JOIN stocks s ON s.symbol = t.symbol WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY t.trade_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY symbol
